<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    istream& in;
    InputReader(istream& stream) : in(stream) {}
    
    string next() {
        string token;
        while (!(in >> token)) {
            if (in.eof()) return "";
        }
        return token;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
    
    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
    
    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(next());
    }
};

class G {
public:
    void run() {
        InputReader in(cin);
        int testNumber = 1;
        TaskE solver;
        solver.solve(testNumber, in, cout);
    }
    
    class TaskE {
    public:
        class MinCostMaxFlow {
        public:
            struct Edge {
                int u, flow, rid, cost;
                Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d) : u(a), flow(b), cost(c), rid(d) {}
            };
            
            vector<vector<Edge>> al;
            vector<vector<Edge>> ja;
            vector<int> d;
            int N, S, T, maxFlow;
            long long minCost;
            const int gmax = INT_MAX / 100;
            int edges = 0;
            
            void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
                int lu = al.size();
                int lv = al.size();
                al.push_back(Edge(v, flow, cost, lv));
                al.push_back(Edge(u, 0, -cost, lu));
            }
            
            void convertToArray() {
                ja.resize(N);
                int idx = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                    int sz = 0;
                    for (int j = 0; j < al.size(); j++) {
                        if (al[j].u == i || (j % 2 == 1 && al[j-1].u == i)) {
                            sz++;
                        }
                    }
                    ja[i].resize(sz);
                    int cnt = 0;
                    for (int j = 0; j < al.size(); j++) {
                        if (al[j].u == i) {
                            ja[i][cnt++] = al[j];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int source, int sink) {
                N = n; S = source; T = sink; maxFlow = 0; minCost = 0;
                al.clear();
                d.assign(N, 0);
            }
            
            bool BellmanFord(bool check) {
                fill(d.begin(), d.end(), gmax);
                d[S] = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < N - 1; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                        for (const Edge& e : ja[j]) {
                            if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                            if (d[j] != gmax && d[j] + e.cost < d[e.u]) {
                                d[e.u] = d[j] + e.cost;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (check) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                        for (const Edge& e : ja[j]) {
                            if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                            if (d[j] != gmax && d[j] + e.cost < d[e.u]) return false;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return true;
            }
            
            vector<int> node;
            vector<int> visit;
            vector<int> prv, prve;
            vector<int> dist;
            
            bool simple() {
                node.assign(N, 0);
                visit.assign(N, 0);
                prv.assign(N, 0);
                prve.assign(N, 0);
                dist.assign(N, gmax);
                node[0] = S; dist[S] = 0;
                int front = 1, back = 0;
                while (front != back) {
                    int u = node[back++];
                    if (back == N) back = 0;
                    visit[u] = 2;
                    for (int i = 0; i < ja[u].size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = ja[u][i];
                        if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                        int cdist = dist[u] + e.cost;
                        if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                            if (visit[e.u] == 0) {
                                node[front] = e.u;
                                if (++front == N) front = 0;
                            } else if (visit[e.u] == 2) {
                                if (--back == -1) back += N;
                                node[back] = e.u;
                            }
                            visit[e.u] = 1;
                            prve[e.u] = i; prv[e.u] = u; dist[e.u] = cdist;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return visit[T] != 0;
            }
            
            struct pair {
                int F, S;
                pair(int a, int b) : F(a), S(b) {}
            };
            
            struct pairCompare {
                bool operator()(const pair& a, const pair& b) {
                    return a.S > b.S;
                }
            };
            
            bool dijkstra() {
                visit.assign(N, 0);
                prv.assign(N, 0);
                prve.assign(N, 0);
                dist.assign(N, gmax);
                fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), gmax);
                priority_queue<pair, vector<pair>, pairCompare> pq;
                pq.push(pair(S, 0)); dist[S] = 0;
                while (!pq.empty()) {
                    pair p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
                    while (dist[p.F] < p.S) {
                        if (pq.empty()) return false;
                        p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
                    }
                    visit[p.F] = 2;
                    for (int i = 0; i < ja[p.F].size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = ja[p.F][i];
                        if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                        int redCost = e.cost + d[p.F] - d[e.u];
                        int cdist = p.S + redCost;
                        if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                            if (visit[e.u] == 2) return false;
                            pq.push(pair(e.u, cdist));
                            dist[e.u] = cdist; prv[e.u] = p.F; prve[e.u] = i;
                            visit[e.u] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
                return visit[T] != 0;
            }
            
            int augment() {
                int p = T; int minFlow = gmax;
                while (p != S) {
                    int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
                    int val = ja[pp][pe].flow;
                    minFlow = min(minFlow, val);
                    p = pp;
                }
                p = T;
                while (p != S) {
                    int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
                    ja[pp][pe].flow -= minFlow;
                    int rid = ja[pp][pe].rid;
                    ja[p][rid].flow += minFlow;
                    p = pp;
                }
                maxFlow += minFlow;
                return minFlow;
            }
            
            bool calSimple() {
                BellmanFord(false);
                while (simple()) {
                    if (dist[T] >= gmax - 1) break;
                    minCost += dist[T] * augment();
                }
                return true;
            }
            
            void updPotential() {
                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                    if (visit[i] != 0) {
                        d[i] += dist[i] - dist[S];
                    }
                }
            }
            
            bool calWithPotential() {
                BellmanFord(false);
                while (dijkstra()) {
                    int min = dist[T] + d[T] - d[S];
                    if (min >= gmax - 1) break;
                    minCost += min * augment();
                    updPotential();
                }
                return true;
            }
        };
        
        int n, m, k, c, d_val;
        vector<int> a, f;
        
        void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, ostream& out) {
            n = in.nextInt(); m = in.nextInt(); k = in.nextInt(); c = in.nextInt(); d_val = in.nextInt();
            int maxl = n + k, T = n * maxl + 1;
            MinCostMaxFlow ans(T + 1, 0, T);
            a.assign(k + 1, 0); f.assign(n + 1, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
                a[i] = in.nextInt();
                f[a[i]]++;
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                if (f[i] == 0) continue;
                ans.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
            }
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
                    ans.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                int u = in.nextInt(), v = in.nextInt();
                for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
                    for (int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                        if (u != 1)
                            ans.addEdge(n * l + u, n * (l + 1) + v, 1, d_val * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                        if (v != 1)
                            ans.addEdge(n * l + v, n * (l + 1) + u, 1, d_val * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int l = 1; l < maxl; l++) {
                ans.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
            }
            ans.convertToArray();
            ans.calWithPotential();
            if (ans.maxFlow != k) {
                out << "BUG" << endl;
            } else {
                out << (int)ans.minCost << endl;
            }
        }
    };
};

int main() {
    G g;
    g.run();
    return 0;
}
